detailed_descriptions_html.en:
RULE THE WORLD

Age of Clicks is a unique blend of Grand Strategy and Idle Progression where you build a nation from the ground up, recruit powerful armies, expand your economy, and wage wars for global domination.

⚔️Build Your Army

Command infantry, armored divisions, heavy artillery, missile launchers, and advanced military technology. Expand your army from a small force into a world-conquering war machine. 

🌍Expand Your Borders

Invade neighboring countries, capture new territories, and slowly paint the entire world in your nation's colors. Every conquered nation unlocks new resources, new challenges, and even greater rewards.

🏭Build a Powerful Economy

A Strong Nation Needs a Strong Industry. Develop cities, build factories, extract resources, and create an economy capable of supporting millions of soldiers. Balance military expansion with economic growth to become an unstoppable superpower.

🚀 Endless Progression

Research technologies, unlock powerful upgrades, automate production, strengthen your military, and discover new ways to dominate the world. There is always another upgrade… and another country waiting to fall.
